messages.破裂と沈潜が大量に付いた敵ほど火力が伸びる打撃人格。「鴻園の君主」ホンルの連携で: A Blunt Identity that deals more damage against enemies with large amounts of Rupture and Sinking. When brought out of standby by The Lord of Hongyuan Hong Lu's coordination, she can use S3 Crushing Horns [破碎角] with 3 Burgeoning of Horns [發角] already active.
messages.「鴻園の君主」ホンルとの連携: 常時発動パッシブ「亡羊之嘆」により、待機解除また: **Coordination with Hong Lu's The Lord of Hongyuan**: Through the passive Lament of the Lost Sheep [亡羊之嘆], which is always active, she gains 3 Burgeoning of Horns [發角] on the turn she appears from backup or returns. The Lord Hong Lu's passive makes Heishou allies who step in from backup or return perform a one-sided attack with basic skill 3 at Combat Start, 2 times per battle per Identity. In other words, an S3 carrying 3 Burgeoning of Horns is fired immediately. Also, triggering Exalted Command with the Lord Hong Lu grants him an enhancement that inflicts 1 Sinking each time his skills inflict Rupture, 3 times per turn.
messages.S3「破砕角」: 使用時に発角3を得る。戦闘開始時に発角があれば全コインが破壊不: **S3 — Crushing Horns [破碎角]**: Gains 3 Burgeoning of Horns on use. If she has Burgeoning of Horns at Combat Start, all Coins become Unbreakable, with +10% damage per stack, up to 30%. Coin Ⅳ deals more damage if the target has a Panic Type change effect and inflicts 3 Shattermark next turn. It grows stronger the more it is used in succession.
messages.破裂・沈潜の合計で強化: 攻撃スキルは対象の破裂と沈潜の合計が6以上なら/につき: **Bonuses from total Rupture and Sinking**: Attack skills gain +1 Coin Power if/for every 6 combined Rupture and Sinking on the target, up to 2. The combat passive Explosive Battering Ram (3 Gluttony and 3 Gloom Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ) gives +1% damage for every 2 of that total, up to 15%, doubled against targets without SP. With Burgeoning of Horns, her final Coin's damage also rises.
messages.発角: 最大3、ターン終了時に1減少。基本スキルで付与する破裂・沈潜の威力+1。: **Burgeoning of Horns**: Maximum 3; decreases by 1 at Turn End. +1 to the Rupture and Sinking Potency inflicted by basic skills. Her Defense skill grants 3 next turn. S2 Seize the Momentum, Shatter the Wall also makes its final Coin Unbreakable if she has Burgeoning of Horns at Combat Start.
messages.破砕痕: 暴食・憂鬱スキルでの被ダメージ量+10%。精神力のある対象はパニックタ: **Shattermark**: +10% damage taken from Gluttony and Gloom skills. It changes the Panic Type of targets with SP and gives −1 Clash Power to targets without SP. S1 Breakthrough deals +25% damage to targets with Shattermark.
messages.自分では破裂・沈潜を多く積めないので、破裂や沈潜を維持する味方と組んで蓄積を任せ: She cannot stack much Rupture or Sinking herself, so pair her with allies who maintain Rupture or Sinking and leave the buildup to them. In regular battles, the efficient approach is to pair her with Hong Lu's The Lord of Hongyuan, place her in a backup slot that will step in, and have her fire S3 with 3 Burgeoning of Horns. When fighting on her own, gain Burgeoning of Horns with S3 or her Defense skill first, then fire S2 and S3 with Unbreakable Coins.
